requirements.statement: With two dispatch slots configured before startup, busy exhaustion refuses a third host registration with history_service_unavailable before registration or claim; known registration replay remains idempotent.
At dispatch exhaustion the host continues serving existing work including a live child; status, result recording and cancellation remain available, and replacement waits for both runs to drain.

After drain the production loop stops the exhausted service promptly; retrying the same third CLI open, including a refreshed advisory availability audit, replays its original account open and successfully dispatches the same account run on a fresh service without another claim or reservation at refusal.
The project_driver.py::_register lifetime-cap entry binds busy refusal, drain and replacement to the two-slot CLI scenario, preserving the original synthetic test.
